name: Blockchain.com Data API (blockchain.info rawaddr / multiaddr / balance)
tier_rationale: Blockchain.com, an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted). Registry tiers: Blockstream, Blockchain.com, BlockCypher and Blockchair trusted; mempool.space and litecoinspace community.

reliability.justification: Explorer API over its own Bitcoin nodes: balances and transactions are chain facts; multiaddr transaction lists carry only the queried wallet's outputs.

data_api.title: Blockchain.com Data API: rawaddr (summary + full txs), multiaddr/balance (batch summaries, %7C separators)

terms.quote: Per-adapter terms recorded: Esplora, mempool, litecoinspace and Blockchain.com 'open'; BlockCypher and Blockchair 'key-terms'.

data_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P211 cond 6). Research C0481 (verified_live 200): rawaddr/{a}?limit=50&offset=k, multiaddr?active=a1%7Ca2 (the separator must be URL-encoded: a raw '|' returned {'error':'invalid address'}), balance?active=a; invalid address -> 404 {'error':'not-found-or-invalid-arg'} (prep live 2026-11-26). Documented ~1 request / 10 s sustained -> min_interval 10 s. Used by btc_explorers (BTC fallback).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-2 (P211). Soft limits ~1 req/10 s (research C0481): min_interval 10 s on the host, crypto ttl 1 h, 5 s timeout; 429 = RATE_LIMITED (host short-circuited for the run).
